title: Kingshot internal hero data (stars + Exclusive Gear/widget data)
notes: Star progression stores the published 31 Expedition ATK/DEF states from the relevant KingshotData hero/generation tables (0-star through 5-star max in the UI).
Only additive Expedition hero stats are represented here. Hero talents and Expedition skill/buff effects are intentionally excluded.
Exclusive Gear/widget passive Lethality and Health are separate from the active widget Expedition skill. The active skill unlocks at Exclusive Gear level 2 and ranks up at levels 4, 6, 8 and 10.
